name: Chatbot IA – AI Assistant for WooCommerce
author: eliseogamba

sections.description:
Chatbot IA adds an AI-powered sales assistant to your WordPress and WooCommerce store. It does more than just answer questions — it acts. When a customer asks about a product, a category, or how to pay, the assistant replies instantly and, when needed, takes them directly to the right page — product page, category, deals, or checkout — without them having to search for it.

One-click setup. Starts working immediately. You just load your knowledge (products, shipping, policies, payment methods) and the assistant uses it to answer with the exact information about your business, 24 hours a day.

Why it helps you sell more

Up to 7 out of 10 customers abandon when they can’t find what they’re looking for. The assistant retains them: answers their question on the spot, detects their intent, and guides them toward the purchase.

Key features

  • Does more than answer — it acts — redirects customers to the product page, category, deals or checkout automatically, and the chat reopens on the new page
  • 24/7 AI responses — trained with your store’s information, answers accurately at any time
  • One-click setup — connect your site and the chat widget appears on your store instantly, no technical configuration needed
  • Free plan included — 100 chat sessions per month, no cost and no credit card required
  • Pro plan available — unlimited sessions, activated from your WordPress dashboard
  • Knowledge base — add your products, policies and FAQs so the bot learns about your business
  • Matches your brand — set your welcome message and brand color from the dashboard
  • Enable / disable the widget anytime, without deactivating the plugin
  • Bilingual admin interface — dashboard available in English and Spanish

Ideal for

WooCommerce stores that want to answer questions instantly, reduce cart abandonment, and sell more without adding support staff.

External service

This plugin connects to the AI assistant service operated by Tu Tienda Online (https://asistente.tutiendaonline.app) to function. The connection is made only when you explicitly activate it from the settings panel. The service is used to:

  • Register your site and issue a unique API key on connection
  • Serve the chat widget JavaScript to your visitors
  • Process chat messages and generate AI responses

Data sent to the service includes your site URL, site name, and admin email (on connection), and visitor chat messages (during conversations). You can review the privacy policy and terms of service at https://asistente.tutiendaonline.app before connecting the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Chatbot IA in your WordPress sidebar and click Connect to activate the assistant. Your site is registered and your key is issued at that moment.
  3. Customize the appearance, set your brand color, and load your knowledge base. The widget appears on your store instantly.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account or enter a credit card?

No. When you connect your site, an account is created automatically using your WordPress admin email. The free plan requires no credit card.

Do I need an OpenAI API key or any other provider?

No. The AI service is already included. You don’t need to sign up for or configure any external AI provider separately.

Will the chatbot slow down my store?

No. The widget loads asynchronously with no heavy frameworks or dependencies, so it won’t affect your store’s speed or Core Web Vitals.

What language does the assistant use to respond to my customers?

The assistant responds based on the content you load in your knowledge base. If you write it in English, it responds in English — you can adapt it to whatever language your store uses.

What happens when I reach the free plan limit?

Once you hit 100 sessions for the month, the widget stops responding until the next month. Or you can upgrade to the Pro plan (unlimited sessions) from the Chatbot IA settings page.

Can I temporarily disable the chat?

Yes. Use the toggle in Chatbot IA → Settings to show or hide the widget without deactivating the plugin.

Is my data and my customers’ data safe?

Chat messages are processed by the Tu Tienda Online AI service solely to generate responses and track session usage. Review the service’s privacy policy before connecting.

What languages is the admin panel available in?

English and Spanish. The plugin automatically uses the language configured in your WordPress installation.
